Here's a summary of the 4 fixes applied:

| Issue | Root Cause | Fix |
|-------|-----------|-----|
| **6 validation runs instead of 3** | `%(ProtoFile.Filename)` + `%(ValidationRule.Filename)` in same task creates a cross-product | Batch on `%(ProtoFile.Filename)` only; list rules via `@(ValidationRule->'%(Filename)', ', ')` |
| **CS2002 duplicate warnings** | Static `Compile Include="**\*.g.cs"` glob catches `obj/` files that the target also adds explicitly | Removed the static glob; `Compile` + metadata added only inside the target |
| **Clean removes too much** | `FileWrites` in a static ItemGroup is evaluated at load time, tracking files even when the target was skipped | Moved `FileWrites` inside `GenerateProtoCode` so only actually-written files are tracked |
| **Clean doesn't delete files** | `CleanGeneratedCode` only did `Compile Remove` — never deleted from disk | Replaced with `<Delete>` task targeting the generated files |

**Bonus fix:** `DependentUpon` metadata was `%(Filename).proto` on `service.g.cs` → resolved to `service.g.proto`. Now correctly uses `%(ProtoFile.Filename).proto` → `service.proto`.
